modelNotes: Team ratings come from score margins (capped at 3) with home advantage, fitted on this and last season with a 480-day half-life; last season counts 0.6x as much on top.
The rest of the regular season is simulated 20,000 times, letting team strength drift (more when more of the season is left), then the playoffs are simulated from each simulated table for title odds.
Tiebreakers are simplified: points, then regulation wins, then wins; head-to-head and common-games rules are not modelled.
